attributes.name: Druva - Backup SLA Violation
attributes.description: Detects resources with backup failures spanning a prolonged period, indicating potential recovery point objective or service-level violations.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects resources with backup failures spanning a prolonged period, indicating potential recovery point objective or service-level violations.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(TO_STRING(message), TO_STRING(druva.event_type), ""))
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(TO_STRING(druva.resource.name), TO_STRING(druva.resource.name), TO_STRING(user.name))
| EVAL event_time = @timestamp
| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL AND event_text LIKE "*backup failed*"
| STATS
    failure_count = COUNT(*),
    first_failure = MIN(event_time),
    last_failure = MAX(event_time)
  BY resource
| EVAL failure_span_hours = DATE_DIFF("hours", first_failure, last_failure)
| WHERE failure_count >= 3 AND failure_span_hours >= 4
